scope_notes: Only public Rhino Point commands, point-object SDK coordinates and Vector3d.IsTiny outputs were inspected in empty owned Rhino documents on private Xvfb. The worker runs at idle outside RunPythonScript Undo.

Eight zero, axis and neighboring-double origins are entered in integer-mantissa round-trip, scientific, fixed and dyadic fractional formats, with and without an explicit ScalePositions reference seed. Four independently owned settings schemes each capture 16 recipes.

Point output is read at EndCommand and after the entire macro. Independent integer IEEE bit expectations distinguish equality at 2^-23 from the next double above it. Format and seed comparisons preserve the exact point bits.

Complete command tests replay all 64 Point recipes. Application tests replay the same prescribed world tokens through complete and incremental Point input for 128 comparisons. Application Undo/Redo checks establish application invariants; Rhino document history is unmeasured.
Completed capture batches are checkpointed atomically and can be reused only with identical request, scheme and source hashes. Failed batches are not normalized into Point results.

The retained custom GetPoint diagnostic timed out before publishing a response after acknowledged input of the negative neighboring value. Its archived probe and driver are historical sources, separate from the successful public Point command capture. It is not counted as a positive geometry comparison.

Point command precision does not establish the actual origin consumed internally by ScalePositions or resolve its two unstable immediate-above boundary recipes. Existing raw captures and parity exclusions remain unchanged.
Oblique construction planes, all expression families, extreme coordinates, SDK GetPoint behavior, unit suffixes in complete commands, full geometry parity and performance are unproven by this matrix.
